title: Homilies on Joshua, Homily 1
blurb: Origen’s Homily 1 on Joshua (Rufinus’s Latin). Complete on this page: §§1–7.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Homily 1 on Joshua — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks these homilies; Bruce FOTC 105 is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Homily 1 §§1–7 (closeout). The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Baehrens, Origenes Werke VII (GCS 30, 1921), Rufinus’s Latin of Homily 1. Bruce FOTC 105 was not used as wording. This page is Homily 1 §§1–7 (closeout).
